question: I have hands but I don't point the way. I have a face but I do not speak. What am I?
What has keys but can't open any doors?
You see me by day; at night I disappear. I give light and warmth. What am I?
I have four legs in the morning, two at noon, and three in the evening. Who am I?
I have no legs but I travel, I have no mouth but I make a sound. I often touch the shore. What am I?
I guard the desert's secrets, with a lion's body and a human face. Who am I?
I am a tall stone structure, thousands of years old, keeper of pharaohs' stories. What am I?
I am a long island, not a road. Surrounded by sea and known for olives, rocks and bays. Who am I?
My name is short but my maritime story is long. I'm on Dugi otok and smell of the sea. What place am I?
I have hundreds of rocky islets, the sea surrounds me and I'm known for unique beauty. Who am I?
You cannot hold me in your hand, yet I can carry the largest ships. What am I?
I carry my house on my back and never hurry. Who am I?
What has teeth but cannot bite?
The more you take from me, the bigger I become. What am I?
White in winter, I fall from the sky and children love me. What am I?
I have a neck but no head. I have a body but don't walk. What am I?
You can't see me but you can feel me. I move leaves and sails. What am I?
I live in the sea, have eight arms and can change color. Who am I?
I write without a pen and speak without a voice. I hold the past of people. What am I?
I run through the desert and bring life for thousands of years. Who am I?
I have wings but I'm not a plane. I fly at night and like darkness. Who am I?
I have branches but no arms. I have leaves but do not read. What am I?
What always goes up but never comes down?
If you have me you want to share me; if you share me you no longer have me. What am I?
What has one foot and wears a hat?
What travels the sea but never gets wet?
Born on an island, neighbor to the sea, ships bring stories. What am I?
On Dugi otok grows a tree that remembers centuries and produces the Mediterranean's gold. What tree is it?
What a sailor sees every day but can never catch?
I wear a crown but I am not a king. I lived by the Nile and ruled a great kingdom. Who am I?
I preserve the words of people who lived before me. I can be old or new. What am I?
You cannot see me but without me there is no life. What am I?
I have spines on my back but I am not a thorn. Who am I?
I have windows but no house. What am I?
I have cities but no houses, rivers but no water. What am I?
I appear after the rain and have seven colors. What am I?
What can fill a room but takes up no space?
I am a white bird by the sea and often follow ships. Who am I?
I have pages and covers but I am not a door. What am I?
What is yours but used more often by others than by you?
I appear at dusk and vanish at dawn. What am I?
I have a tail but I am not an animal. I sail the sea and carry people. What am I?
What goes up and down but stays in the same place?
I have a screen but I'm not a window. I have memory but I'm not a person. What am I?
I drive windmills and sails though you cannot see me. What am I?
I can carry a house on my back but I am not an architect. Who am I?
I am born in clouds, fall to the earth and feed the land. What am I?
Which fish can write?
I guard the desert's peace, my body belongs to a lion and my face to a human. Who am I?
I have keys but no locks. What am I?
I have root, trunk and crown. What am I?
I have eight legs and live in the sea. Who am I?
What has eyes but cannot see?
I have hands but I cannot hug. I have a face but cannot speak. What am I?
What can cross an ocean while staying in the same place?
I am a long island in the Adriatic, known for nature, olives and Sali. Who am I?
My name is short but my maritime history is long. I am on Dugi otok. What place am I?
I have no legs but I dance. I have no voice but I sing near the shore. What am I?
I guard the desert entrance and ask travelers questions. I have a lion's body and a human head. Who am I?
I have a beak and feathers and often fly over the seas. What am I?
I have one leg and wear a hat. What am I?
I have a root and a crown. What am I?
A sailor follows me but never reaches me. What am I?
What grows when shared?
What goes up and down but stays in the same place?
I have keys and a player loves me. What am I?
I have water, life and fruits. What am I?
I can be calm like a mirror or wild like a storm. What am I?
I have spines and like the night. Who am I?
Pharaohs built me, the desert guards me and people visit me for thousands of years. What am I?
I shine at night in the cold season and melt in the sun. What am I?
Which key doesn't open doors?
I have pages and words. What am I?
Which gas has no smell, no taste and no color, yet is essential for life?
I have waves that sometimes whisper to the shore. What am I?
I have coves and streets of stone. People call me home. What am I?
What is yours but others use it more often than you do?
I have a mane and am the king in tales of the wild. Who am I?
I write without a pen and keep the past of people's stories. What am I?
What has teeth but does not eat?
I sing on the tree in warm evenings. Who am I?
What rises and falls but never leaves the shore?
I have keys and screens and often live in a pocket. What am I?
You cannot see me but without me plants would not grow. What am I?
My body is lion-like and my face is human; I am the guardian of ancient stories. Who am I?
What is shapeless but everyone loves it?
I smell of the sea and often grow by the shore. What am I?
I have waves and depths. Many creatures live in me. What am I?
On my edge there are bays and rocks. Who am I?
Which object has the most pages?
What comes once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years?
I have musical strings and you play me with your fingers. What am I?
I have feathers and I fly. Who am I?
I am green, I grow and I give shade. What am I?
Sometimes I carry ships, sometimes I cast them ashore. What am I?
I keep stories of old times and the names of leaders. What am I?
They stand proudly in the desert and remind of ancient power. What are they?
Which bee makes money?
I have a screen and light and you use me for watching. What am I?
Without me there is no inner light; we all breathe me. What am I?
What has no beginning and no end but everyone sees it?
What stretches between coast and sky?
Where olives grow and the sea kisses the stone?
I live in schools and swim in large groups. Who am I?
I melt in spring and form in clouds. What am I?
What is always ahead of you but you cannot see it?
I have hoops and a ball and you play me on a court. What am I?
What always increases but never decreases?
A small green leaf that grows from a stem. What am I?
A strong wind that creates large waves. What am I?
A small insect that sings in summer. Who am I?
A narrow piece of cloth you wear around your neck. What am I?
What has four wheels and flies?
A large fire burning in nature and fed by wind. What am I?
Sometimes blue, sometimes green; always vast. What am I?
Which is faster: light or sound?
Mysterious symbols carved in stone. What are they?
A metal object that turns a lock. What am I?
Large and strong like a tree, growing deep in the earth. What am I?
A calm sea surface without wind is often called what?
A small animal that lives in colonies and builds tunnels. Who am I?
What can you break but never lift?
I have numbers but I'm not a book; I'm used for calculations. What am I?
An old monument that tells stories of people before us. What am I?
A light that helps ships find their way. What is it?
A place of stone houses, salt and olives as daily life. Where am I?
A small particle that makes up everything around us. What is it?
What contains a lot of attention but never complains?
A frame for pictures hanging on a wall. What is it?
The movement of air we can feel. What is it?
A small rodent that loves cheese. Who am I?
What has many keys but doesn't play music by itself?
A friend of the fish, sails the sea and has a sail. What is it?
A large body of water that flows through the land. What is it?
Soft and warm, you wear it on your head when it's cold. What is it?
Which silver thing shines in the dark?
Which number comes after two?
Swims and often carries shells; sometimes it's food. What is it?
A place where people fish and sing in the evenings. Where am I?
A small flower that smells and grows in a garden. What is it?
What has handles and carries water?
Without what can plants not grow?
What is small, round and loves to dance?
I have a beginning but often no end. What am I?
What can break the shore and return to the distance?
A large creature living in the sea with big teeth. Who am I?
A metal item that holds papers together. What is it?
A big green insect that flies and sings. Who am I?
A place where old stories and documents are kept. What is it?
What is round and travels the world but stays on the desk?
I have high peaks and sometimes snow on top. What am I?
A sharp tool that cuts and is often used in the kitchen. What is it?
What always comes but never arrives now?
The blue line that meets the sky. What is it?
A large stone landmark looking to east and west. What is it?
A small sea creature with a shell. What is it?
What shines at night and helps us see the sky?
What has a head, a tail and a body but no bones?
An old stringed instrument used for classical music. What is it?
I have doors but no people; I have windows but no rooms. What am I?
I rise and fall, go away and come back. What am I?
An island with rocky shores and the scent of olives. What am I?
I carry food and am often used at meals. What am I?
Small and soft, I grow in the grass and bees love me. What am I?
What is blue and can't swim?
Which question never asks for an answer?
Name the gas that sustains life. What is it?
An old inscription in stone that tells about people before us. What is it?
I have a long tail and often jump between branches. Who am I?
Sometimes salty, sometimes calm; always endless. What am I?
A two-layer paper for writing messages. What is it?
What can you break without touching it?
What grows in the ground, bears fruit and feeds us?
